description: Covered call figures for shares already held: premium income, breakeven, maximum profit if the shares are called away, the return if the stock is unchanged and the downside cushion, each for the length of the trade. Says when the strike is below the cost basis, and when no stock price breaks even.

contracts.description: Number of contracts, 100 shares each. Default 1.
contracts.title: Contracts

cost_basis.description: What the shares cost per share, in dollars. Defaults to the stock price.
cost_basis.title: Cost Basis

premium.description: Premium received per share, in dollars.
premium.title: Premium

strike.description: The strike of the call sold, in dollars.
strike.title: Strike

name: covered_call
title: Covered call calculator
